title: Form section
summary: A titled section of a form: heading and description beside a responsive grid of fields (stacked below 1024px).

props.name: heading
props.description: The section heading (or use the heading slot).

slots.description: The fields. Give a child class form-span to make it span the full width.

cssProperties.name: --pk-form-section-column
cssProperties.description: Minimum column width of the field grid.

a11y: The heading is a real h2 so the section is navigable by heading; the fields keep their own labels.

examples.title: Two sections
examples.html: <pk-form-section heading="Profile" description="Shown on invoices."><pk-field label="Business name"><pk-input></pk-input></pk-field><pk-field label="Website"><pk-input type="url"></pk-input></pk-field></pk-form-section>
